# 37 workbench examples return their config instead of an instance

## Context

This is split from #22066 so it can run in parallel before the Engine 14 cut; the operator asked for D#21480 in the cut. #22066 makes the workbench code view show an example's authored config. It can only show that config when `createExampleComponent()` returns it, and these 37 examples create their instance themselves. The conversions are mechanical, and each one is independent of the others and of #22066.

## The Problem

At `6bce66de69`, these call `Neo.create()` inside `createExampleComponent()` and return the instance, so the viewport never sees the config they wrote (paths under `examples/`, each `MainContainer.mjs`):

`button/effect` `button/split` `component/canvas` `component/carousel` `component/chip` `component/circle` `component/clock` `component/dateSelector` `component/mwc/button` `component/mwc/textField` `component/process` `component/process/realWorldExample` `component/progress` `component/statusbadge` `component/timer` `component/video` `component/wrapper/monacoEditor` `container/accordion` `container/fragment` `date/selectorContainer` `form/field/picker` `form/fieldset` `functional/button/base` `layout/card` `layout/cube` `layout/form` `list/buffered` `list/chip` `list/circle` `list/color` `menu/list` `menu/panel` `menu/tree` `sitemap` `table/container` `tree` `treeAccordion`

(`tab/container`, `button/base` and `list/base` convert in #22066. `component/splitter`, `fieldWithPrefix` and `popover` build differently and stay as they are. The first version of this list left out `functional/button/base`, because my exclusion pattern for `button/base` matched it too; @neo-gemini-maryam caught that on this ticket.)

## The Architectural Reality

`ConfigurationViewport#onConstructed()` already creates a returned object or class (`examples/ConfigurationViewport.mjs:810-817`), so returning the config builds the same component. Design authority: [D#21480's OQ7 disposition](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/21480#discussioncomment-19822656).

## The Fix

- `return Neo.create({...})` becomes `return {...}`.
- `return Neo.create(Class, {...})` becomes `return {module: Class, ...}`.
- An example that works on its instance before returning moves that work to after creation, through the viewport's existing hooks or its siblings' pattern.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Each of the 37 returns its config from `createExampleComponent()`.
- [ ] Each renders and behaves as before. The existing workbench specs pass, and so does a smoke run that opens every converted example.
- [ ] Once #22066 is on `dev`, each code view shows the authored config.
- [ ] No file under `src/` changes.

## Out of Scope

The code view and the formatter (#22066), and the engine contract (D#21480).
